market_events.text: Result: ARI lost to DEN 16–30 (vs DEN)

matchups.lede: The biggest mismatch: DAL's passing offense (12th) against ARI's pass defense (32nd).

conditions.label: Pass better
conditions.definition: More EPA per dropback than the opponent (sacks and scrambles count; win probability 20-80%).
conditions.help: Season-to-date EPA per dropback predicts the game's difference with r +0.20 (2006-2025): weakly predictable. It is also close to the result itself: a team that passes well scores.

conditions.label: Win early downs
conditions.definition: The team's EPA per play on first and second down (win probability 20-80%) beats the opponent's.
conditions.help: Season-to-date early-down EPA predicts the game's with r +0.17 (2006-2025): weakly predictable.

conditions.label: Sack the quarterback more
conditions.definition: The opponent's offense was sacked at least two more times than this team's.
conditions.help: Season-to-date sack rates predict the game's sack margin with r +0.15 (2006-2025): weakly predictable.

conditions.label: Win the turnover battle
conditions.definition: Takeaways minus giveaways (interceptions and lost fumbles) of at least +1.
conditions.help: Before a game, both teams' turnover rates to date predict its turnover margin with r +0.005 (2006-2025): a coin flip for every team.

conditions.label: Win third down
conditions.definition: A higher third-down conversion rate than the opponent.
conditions.help: Season-to-date third-down rates predict the game's difference with r +0.15 (2006-2025): weakly predictable.

conditions.label: More explosive plays
conditions.definition: More passes of 20+ yards and runs of 10+ yards than the opponent.
conditions.help: Season-to-date explosive plays predict the game's with r +0.16 (2006-2025): weakly predictable.

conditions.label: More big runs
conditions.definition: More runs of 10+ yards than the opponent.
conditions.help: Season-to-date 10-yard runs predict the game's difference with r +0.22 (2006-2025): weakly predictable.

conditions.label: Run more efficiently
conditions.definition: A higher rush success rate than the opponent (win probability 20-80%).
conditions.help: Season-to-date rush success predicts the game's difference with r +0.13 (2006-2025): weakly predictable.

conditions.label: Win special teams
conditions.definition: Special-teams EPA at least +3 points better than the opponent's.
conditions.help: Not measured before the game; the history says what winning dogs did, nothing about whether either team tends to produce it.

conditions.label: Finish in the red zone
conditions.definition: A higher touchdown rate on drives that reach the opponent's 20.
conditions.help: Season-to-date red-zone touchdown rates predict the game's difference with r +0.04 (2006-2025): a coin flip for every team.

conditions.label: More deep completions
conditions.definition: More completions of 20+ yards than the opponent.
conditions.help: Season-to-date 20-yard completions predict the game's difference with r +0.14 (2006-2025): weakly predictable.
